name: Fish Audio S2 Pro
purpose: TTS with fine-grained inline control of prosody and emotion via free-form [tag] instructions; weights, fine-tuning code and a streaming engine released (card).

license.name: Fish Audio Research License
license.notes: LICENSE.md in the repo read. Sec. III: "Any use of the Fish Audio Materials or Derivative Works for a Commercial Purpose requires a separate written license agreement from Fish Audio." Commercial includes internal business operations and any hosted service or API. Distribution of non-commercial use needs the license copy, a Notice file and "Built with Fish Audio". The GitHub code repo carries a different file (Fish Audio Community License) that covers the code, not these weights. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: AUTOREGRESSIVE Dual-AR: ~4B slow AR (semantic codebook, time axis) + ~400M fast AR (9 residual codebooks), RVQ codec 10 codebooks at ~21 Hz
architecture.why_this_design: Slow AR on the time axis, fast AR for the residual codebooks at each step (card).

benchmarks.name: German WER on MiniMax TTS-Multilingual-Test-Set (SIM 0.714)
benchmarks.harness: table in the Ming-3.0-tts-tiny card (a competitor, same ASR-based protocol for all rows)

weaknesses: No VRAM figure, no quality table

user_reports.summary: Users report that emotion/prosody tags are mostly ignored when a cloned voice is used (only occasional [laugh]/[inhale] work).

tona_fit.reason: High quality (German WER 1.045 on the MiniMax set, a third-party table via the Ming card) and a 4B slow autoregressive model that suits Tona, but 12 and 16 GB cards do not fit it (24 GB marginal). Watch until a quantized path for 16 GB exists.
